Status: SNN experimental feature safely integrated & observable; not production-ready until evaluation + guard enforcement completed.

\n+## 2025-09-03 Secret & Reliability Hardening
ID: A19
Summary: Completed Batch 2 hardening: startup delay jitter, inline flush test, secret scanning script, unified secret loader with fingerprint logging, security practices documentation, secret loader tests. Solidified reliability amendment (A11) with additional evidence and guarded startup variance to ensure reproducible anomaly presence pre-SNN scaling.
Artifacts: src/core/main.py (startup jitter), tests/test_flush_inline_path.py, scripts/scan_secrets.py, src/config/secret_loader.py, docs/SECURITY_PRACTICES.md, tests/test_secret_loader.py
Rationale: Reduce risk of false-zero anomaly exports due to timing/race, establish foundational secret hygiene ahead of persistence (Neon/Redis) integration, and document operational security baseline for future audits.
Controls Added:
 - Startup jitter (random sleep up to baseline.warmup_jitter_max_s) prevents synchronized multi-instance cold start spike & warm-up artifact.
 - Secret scanner (JWT / npg_ / long hex) enables pre-commit & CI leakage detection.
 - Flush path test ensures deterministic queue drain semantics with inline detection coexistence.
 - SECURITY_PRACTICES.md codifies current + planned measures; improves auditability and onboarding clarity.
 - Secret loader test enforces no raw secret logged, required flag semantics.
Residual Risks: Single-factor admin API key (HMAC optional), no vault/KMS yet, secret scan heuristic (potential false negatives for exotic formats), anomaly log rotation deferred.
Next: Integrate persistence (Neon) using secret loader, implement signed manifests (ed25519), per-tenant scoped keys, and vector embedding store with provenance signature chain.
Status: Implemented – Batch 2 closed; foundation ready for persistence & embedding phase.

## 2025-09-04 Scanner Pivot Checkpoint & Precision Penalty Integration
ID: A20
Summary: Established formal pivot checkpoint transitioning from always-on streaming expansion toward a lightweight batch/CLI "scanner" mode to rapidly validate neuromorphic (SNN + fusion) value with strict reproducibility. Integrated precision-proxy false-positive penalty into fusion weight tuner, added fusion reliability variance gate extension, analyst-facing tuner rationale doc, detector status & insights demonstration scripts, and pivot decision record enabling reversible scope shift.
Artifacts: docs/SCANNER_PIVOT_DECISION.md, docs/ANALYST_TUNER_OVERVIEW.md, scripts/run_tuner.py (FP penalty + history), scripts/run_reliability_check.py (fusion variance compare), scripts/print_detector_status.py, scripts/demo_insights_policy.py, README.md (updated features section).
Rationale: Reduce time-to-evidence for neuromorphic uplift by introducing a controlled scanner workflow (deterministic batch ingestion + report) before adding further continuous temporal complexity. Ensures governance (audit trail + rollback) and analyst transparency (tuner reasoning) while preventing silent precision regression via new FP penalty mechanism.
Controls Added:
	- Precision proxy false-positive penalty: tuner now demotes weights when observed precision falls below configured floor; reason codes logged per adjustment.
	- Weight history JSONL log (scripts/run_tuner.py) for temporal explainability and forensic review.
	- Fusion reliability variance extension: compares fused anomaly rate variance vs baseline-only to guard against instability when fusion strategy enabled.
	- Detector status script enumerating active detectors, versions, and current weights (operator quick health check).
	- Insights + policy enrichment demo script validating end-to-end enrichment/redaction path prior to scanner adaptation.
	- Pivot decision document capturing rationale, scope boundaries, and success criteria (time-boxed value proof, reproducible uplift metrics, reversible path).
Rollback / Reversal Guidance:
	1. Disable scanner mode (future flag) and re-enable streaming orchestrator defaults; ensure `detection.enable_snn` and `detection.fusion.strategy` aligned with prior manifest snapshot.
	2. Regenerate manifest chain (scripts/verify_integrity.py) and compare against MANIFEST_CHAIN to confirm no untracked drift.
	3. Revert tuner penalty thresholds by applying prior param values from param_changes.log (search reasons containing "pre-pivot").
	4. If scanner introduces schema or artifact directories, archive them under `archives/pivot_A20/` to prevent contamination of continuous metrics.
Success Criteria for Pivot Phase:
	- Demonstrate reproducible uplift: fused_or_snn_precision - baseline_precision >= configured minimal_delta (target >= +0.05 absolute) on two independent batch runs.
	- Maintain variance guard: fused anomaly rate variance <= 1.25x baseline variance across replay.
	- FP penalty triggers <= 10% of tuner cycles after stabilization window (indicates controlled precision profile).
	- Analyst explanation completeness: every weight adjustment has non-empty reason and precision/unique_ratio context fields.
Out-of-Scope (Deferred to Post-Pivot): Multi-tenant hardening for scanner outputs, signed ed25519 manifests, advanced temporal transformer training, production persistence (Neon/Redis) integration.
Residual Risks: Scanner path not yet implemented (architectural spec & CLI flag forthcoming); absence of signed weight history leaves tamper window (mitigate by planned signature chain). FP penalty thresholds heuristic—could over-demote under rare concept drift; will calibrate via initial pilot runs.
Next: (1) Append architectural ASCII spec for scanner workflow (ingest → normalize → detectors → fusion → report) (2) Draft five strategic option briefs (scanner variants + knowledge/NLP layer integration) (3) Knowledge graph/RAG integration plan (ontology + provenance) (4) Add audit entry linking completed architecture & options (A21) (5) Implement minimal scanner CLI with deterministic seed & snapshot hash.
Status: Pivot checkpoint recorded; engineering changes deployed and auditable. Proceeding to architecture & strategic options documentation.

## 2025-09-03 Feedback & Insight Enrichment Scaffold (A18)
Summary: Added feedback ingestion endpoint (POST /feedback) with append-only hash-chained log, insight context enrichment attaching top-k retrieval chunks for high-severity insights, lightweight governance validation pruning invalid provenance, and supporting params/flags.
Artifacts: src/core/main.py (/feedback endpoint + enrichment), src/core/feedback/store.py (hash chain log), src/config/runtime_params.py (feedback & insight params), src/config/flags.py (FEEDBACK_INGEST_ENABLED, INSIGHT_CONTEXT_ENRICH_ENABLED), tests/test_feedback_and_enrichment.py
Params: feedback.max_note_length, insight.context.min_severity, insight.context.top_k
Flags: NEURON_FEEDBACK_INGEST_ENABLED, NEURON_INSIGHT_CONTEXT_ENRICH_ENABLED
Governance: Each feedback record chained via prev hash; enrichment governance agent emits decision audit on context pruning (runtime_params.audit_agent_decision).
Rationale: Establish analyst feedback loop & contextual enrichment foundation enabling downstream active learning and multi-agent orchestration.
Risks: No rate limiting on feedback endpoint (future hardening), potential growth of feedback log (rotation param deferred), retrieval category query naive (uses insight category string for context retrieval).
Next: Temporal state persistence + composite risk scoring (temporal persistence P0), model snapshot persistence for Isolation Forest (if required), active learning weighting scaffold (deferred), feedback quality metrics.
\n+### A17 Hybrid Retrieval Scoring Implementation (2025-09-03)
Summary: Activated previously stubbed hybrid retrieval scoring path. Implemented TF-IDF style weighting producing composite score = (1-w)*coverage + w*idf_coverage with idf(t)=1+ln(N/(1+df(t))). Added explanation fields (idf_coverage, embedding_weight, composite, scoring_mode) when `retrieval.scoring.mode` == 'hybrid'. Backward compatible: default keyword mode unchanged; existing tests unaffected. New test `tests/test_rag_hybrid_scoring.py` validates presence of hybrid fields.
Artifacts: scripts/rag_ingest.py (hybrid scoring logic), src/core/retrieval/interface.py (runtime retrieval hybrid support), tests/test_rag_hybrid_scoring.py
Params: retrieval.scoring.mode (keyword|hybrid), retrieval.hybrid.embedding_weight (0..1 clamp)
Rationale: Enables incremental relevance quality improvement & prepares path for future embedding integration without external vector store dependency.
Risks: IDF computed in-memory per index load (O(V)) acceptable at current scale; no persistence changes. Future embedding integration will require governance entry.
